subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature now, including the new authenticated microphone-audio RPC?
rationale: The design is more aligned than direct browser Web Speech, but accepting browser microphone audio through a new Gateway transcription method is a product and security-boundary choice that source review cannot authorize alone.

options.title: Continue After Proof And Fixes
options.body: Require a current-main port, the accessibility/docs-map fixes, and redacted successful microphone-to-Gateway-to-editable-draft proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Behind The Feature Issue
options.body: Keep this PR and the paired feature issue open while maintainers decide whether core should own editable dictation now.

options.title: Supersede With A Fresh Branch
options.body: Close or replace this branch if maintainers prefer a narrower current-main implementation over repairing the conflicting PR head.

recommendation.title: Continue After Proof And Fixes
recommendation.body: Require a current-main port, the accessibility/docs-map fixes, and redacted successful microphone-to-Gateway-to-editable-draft proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged server-side dictation feature and the paired product/security boundary history point most strongly to steipete for the acceptance decision.
